title: 5G NR LDPC base graphs and per-i_LS shift tables (BG1+BG2, key rates)
description:
## Goal

Land the 3GPP TS 38.212 LDPC base graphs (BG1, BG2) and the per-`i_LS`
shift tables for all 8 lifting sets covering rates {1/3, 1/2, 2/3,
5/6}. Verified bit-exact vs the 3GPP reference test vectors.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR + research enablers) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Per-`i_LS` correctness is a known trap
(memory rule `feedback_ldpc_shift_tables`: single lifting-set tables
cause ~2 dB BLER loss). The 5G NR LDPC support partially exists in
`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/` already; this task completes the
coverage and validates against the reference.

## Deliverables

1. Audit + completion of `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/` (or
   parallel directory if not present today):
   - BG1 base graph matrix per TS 38.212 §5.3.2 Table 5.3.2-2.
   - BG2 base graph matrix per TS 38.212 §5.3.2 Table 5.3.2-3.
   - Per-`i_LS` shift table for all 8 lifting sets per Tables
     5.3.2-2 and 5.3.2-3 (the `V` matrices).
   - Lifting size set enumeration: Table 5.3.2-1 (8 sets × multiple
     `Z` values).
2. Test vector validation:
   - Reference test vectors from 3GPP TS 38.212 §5.3.2 sample data
     or from a widely available open implementation (aff3ct's 5G NR
     LDPC test vectors are a viable source).
   - One bit-exact encode-then-decode regression per (BG, `i_LS`,
     `Z`, rate) combination in scope.
3. Public API in `gf2-coding`:
   - `gf2_coding::ldpc::nr_5g::{BaseGraph, ShiftTable, LiftingSet}`
     types.
   - `BaseGraph::bg1(rate: NrRate, lifting_set: i_LS, z: u32)` and
     `bg2(...)` constructors.
4. Data files:
   - `crates/gf2-coding/data/ldpc/nr_5g/bg1_shifts.toml`
   - `crates/gf2-coding/data/ldpc/nr_5g/bg2_shifts.toml`
   - Schema: indexed by `(i_LS, row, col) -> shift_value`.
5. CLAUDE.md note pointing to the new module in the "gf2-coding
   module map" section under `ldpc/` (folded into Phase E close at
   `110e45cc`; this task only contributes the diff).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] BG1 + BG2 + per-`i_LS` shift tables for all 8 lifting sets
  and rates {1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6} present and verified bit-exact
  against TS 38.212 reference test vectors (one regression test
  per (BG, `i_LS`, `Z`, rate) combination).
- [hard] Per-`i_LS` indexing tested explicitly: a regression
  forcing the WRONG `i_LS` table for a given `Z` value yields a
  test failure (proves the indexing matters).
- [hard] Public API on `gf2_coding::ldpc::nr_5g` constructs valid
  base graphs for any in-scope (BG, lifting set, rate) tuple.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `tests` gates green.

## Non-goals

- GPU kernel tuning (owned by `23d3525f`).
- Encoder GPU offload (epic non-goal).
- Rate matching, HARQ buffer (out of scope; epic is LDPC core
  only).
